chat.title: AI Assistant
chat.intro: Ask me anything about Raphaël's background, projects, and technical decisions. Answers are grounded in the actual portfolio content, with citations.
chat.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.rateLimited: Too many questions in a short time. Please try again in a minute.
chat.disclaimer: AI-generated answers based on the portfolio content — they may contain mistakes.
chat.suggestion1: How is this site's RAG system architected (retrieval, embeddings, LLM)?
chat.suggestion2: What AI agents has he built?
chat.suggestion3: Has he deployed an ML model to production?
chat.suggestion4: Which degree specialized him in AI / data science?
chat.suggestion5: Does he have experience with open-source LLMs like Qwen3?
chat.systemPromptSummary: View the system prompt used to generate answers
chat.systemPromptNote: The actual backend (RAG) system prompt, prepended to the vector-search context and the user's question — kept in French, as defined in the source code.
chat.exampleChunkSummary: View an example chunk retrieved via vector search
chat.exampleChunkNote: Each chunk corresponds to a section of the site's content, indexed with its embedding; this is the format that feeds the prompt's context above.
